description: This file contains type definitions, class interfaces, and method signatures for the Phoenix WebSockets library, including core classes like Socket, Channel, Push, and Presence, as well as related types and utility classes.

classes.name: Push
classes.description: Represents a push message over a WebSocket, with methods to send, resend, and handle receipt of specific statuses.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket channel with methods to join, leave, push messages, and handle events.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Core WebSocket connection object with methods for connection management, channel handling, and messaging.

classes.name: LongPoll
classes.description: Fallback transport class for polling-based communication.

classes.name: Ajax
classes.description: Utility class for making AJAX requests.

classes.name: Presence
classes.description: Tracks user presence within channels, with methods for syncing state and list management.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: Utility class for scheduling timed callbacks with exponential backoff.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the push message over the WebSocket.

methods.name: resend
methods.description: Resends the push message with a specified timeout.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a channel, returning a Push instance.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Leaves a channel, returning a Push instance.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a channel for a specific topic.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Pushes an event with payload to the channel.
